text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the sitters, dog walkers, and managers for going above and beyond expectations. Clients highlight team members like Robb, Elise, and Caroline for their attentiveness, reliability, and willingness to resolve urgent household issues. Reviewers emphasize that staff treat pets with the same dedication as their own family animals.

Clients note that sitters handle dogs and cats with tremendous gentleness, patience, and sensitivity. Reviewers with shy or fearful cats appreciate how quickly sitters were able to build trust and calm their pets. Dog owners also report that their pups return from walks feeling happy, exercised, and completely relaxed.

Reviewers appreciate the thorough communication provided after each scheduled walk and sitting visit. Clients report receiving high-quality photos, detailed notes about their pets' moods, and prompt updates through the scheduling application. Handlers note that office management communicates clearly regarding changes or special requests.

q.en: Does Green Paws Chicago offer cat sitting services?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently book drop-in cat sitting for daily check-ins and extended vacation coverage.

q.en: How does the company keep owners updated during visits?

a.en: Sitters provide written visit notes and photo updates after every dog walk or pet sitting appointment.

q.en: Can staff handle pets that are fearful or shy around strangers?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviewers note that sitters were able to bond comfortably with shy, skittish cats and nervous dogs.
